trap.label: supposed to
trap.wrong: You are suppose to arrive at nine.
trap.right: You are supposed to arrive at nine.
trap.why: Pela pronúncia, o /d/ final de supposed some, e o aluno escreve suppose. Na estrutura be supposed to, o -d é obrigatório.

mcq.why: Evidência presente + causa passada = must have + particípio.

mcq.q: "I had my phone stolen" pode indicar...
mcq.why: have + objeto + particípio também indica experiência negativa.

fix.right: Students are supposed to wear shoes.

fix.wrong: He must of taken the bus.
fix.right: He must have taken the bus.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com can't have: “Tom was at home.” (impossível)
rewrite.answer: Tom can't have been at home.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com have: “A mechanic checked our car.”
Reescreva com warned: “‘Don't touch it,’ he said to us.”
rewrite.answer: He warned us not to touch it.
